A '''[[Bosph (species)|Bosph]] bounty hunter''' was among the many [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] who answered [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] call to hunt [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Hoth campaign]] of [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].
